# 0.2.1 — CIRCL Vulnerability-Lookup for CVE

18 September 2026. Patch on the public **0.2.0** beta.

## Install

```bash
pip install opentide==0.2.1
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
```

## Added

- CVE validation and generated threat CVE tables use [CIRCL Vulnerability-Lookup](https://vulnerability.circl.lu) instead of scraping NVD through `mitrecve` ([#109](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/109)).
- `opentide validate --check cve` looks up CVE, GHSA, and GCVE identifiers (`GET /api/vulnerability/{id}`). Empty JSON means unknown. GNA 0 GCVE ids (`GCVE-0-YEAR-N`) map to the reserved CVE key.
- Generated threat docs link to `https://vulnerability.circl.lu/vuln/{id}` and can enrich published date, severity, and aliases when `[cve].retrieve_details` is true.
- `threat.cve` is a first-class optional list on the threat body.

## Changed

- Bundled `documentation.toml` `[cve]` defaults to Vulnerability-Lookup. Legacy NVD `default_db_link` values are remapped.
- The CVE check stays **opt-in** (`--check cve`) so default `opentide validate` stays offline.

## Verify

```bash
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"
opentide setup --yes --name "Tutorial Detections" --org "Example Corp" --platform sentinel --path /tmp/tutorial-detections
opentide --repo /tmp/tutorial-detections generate
opentide --repo /tmp/tutorial-detections validate --strict
opentide --repo /tmp/tutorial-detections validate --check cve
```

Expect `0.2.1`. `.opentide/templates/threat.1.0.template.yaml` must contain `#cve:`. CVE lookup is network-backed; identifiers that CIRCL does not know fail the opt-in check. Default `opentide validate` (no `--check cve`) must not contact Vulnerability-Lookup.
